data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 2b075b447918e7bac776912898a5c637e2a6c739
* **Affected components:** /dso:sprint Phase F Step 18 (ci-pr branch), `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-story-branch.sh`, `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-story-merge-trailer.sh`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` llm-review job (lines 363, 483-499, 570-578), `merge-to-main.sh` ci-pr story-PR creation path.
* **Triggering session:** sprint of epic 1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad (closed P1=PASS); session PR #349 to main. Per-story PRs #353, #355, #356, #357, #359, #361 already auto-merged into session branch worktree-20260525-130447. llm-review on PR #349 still pending after ~25min, reviewing full PR diff (~7000 lines) instead of cross-story integration boundary.

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (internal-dogfood — user asked whether llm-review was skipping already-reviewed Story PRs; investigation showed it is reviewing the entire PR diff because INTEGRATION_SCOPE is empty)

#### Expected Behavior

Per db71-e078-ec99-4fbf (closed) and ci.yml lines 363/483-499/570-578, when sprint Phase F merges story branches into the session branch, each story merge commit SHOULD carry a `DSO-Story-Merge: <story-id>` trailer. ci.yml's "Compute cross-branch file set from DSO-Story-Merge trailers" step enumerates these trailers to construct INTEGRATION_SCOPE — the cross-story integration surface — and llm-review reviews only that scope.

The db71 fix added `merge-story-branch.sh` Phase F Step 18 invocation with empty-trailer-commit fallback when story tip == session tip. The fix targets `local` mode (direct git merge written by `merge-story-branch.sh`).

#### Actual Behavior

In **ci-pr mode**, sprint Phase F Step 18 invokes `merge-to-main.sh` with `STORY_PR_BASE=$SESSION_BRANCH`, which creates a `story/<epic>/<story>` -> session-branch GitHub PR. GitHub's auto-merge then creates the merge commit. This merge commit is created server-side by GitHub and is NEVER touched by `merge-story-branch.sh` — therefore no `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailer is written.

Empirical evidence on session branch worktree-20260525-130447 (PR #349):

```
$ git log origin/main..HEAD --grep='Merge pull request' --oneline | head
635a6d6d1f Merge pull request #361 from navapbc/story/1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad/7f76-...
eb222d6804 Merge pull request #359 from navapbc/story/1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad/00ef-...
ed60dee2d5 Merge pull request #357 from navapbc/story/1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad/c7f3-...
eeee5cf0c1 Merge pull request #356 from navapbc/story/1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad/beaa-...
84ddc7d8ba Merge pull request #355 from navapbc/story/1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad/917a-...
f8919f360d Merge pull request #353 from navapbc/story/1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad/6ba0-...

$ git log origin/main..HEAD --grep='^DSO-Story-Merge:' --oneline
(empty — zero trailers on the session branch)
```

All 6 story PRs auto-merged. None carry the DSO-Story-Merge trailer. ci.yml's INTEGRATION_SCOPE computation finds zero story trailers → emit-missing-trailer-warning.sh fires → llm-review falls through to the full PR diff (documented fallback at ci.yml:570-578).

Sprint SKILL.md Phase F Step 18 acknowledges this in a comment: 'in ci-pr mode, the DSO-Story-Merge trailer is NOT added locally — GitHub creates the merge commit when it auto-merges the story->session PR. The S5 provenance verifier uses GitHub API signals as the primary provenance source in ci-pr mode (not the trailer).'

**The gap**: ci.yml's INTEGRATION_SCOPE computation still relies exclusively on the local `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailer. It has no GitHub-API-based fallback to derive per-story file sets from the auto-merged PRs (#353-#361). The S5 provenance verifier may use GitHub API signals, but INTEGRATION_SCOPE itself does not — so the smart-scoping path is degraded to "warn + full-diff fallback" on every ci-pr sprint.

Net effect: db71's intended improvement (scoped integration review) does NOT materialize in ci-pr mode — the canonical/default sprint mode. Every ci-pr session PR pays the cost of a full-diff cumulative review, even though per-story `review-sub-pr.yml` reviews already passed for each story PR. The review is duplicated and the user waits ~25+ minutes per session-PR for a redundant review.

### 3. Action History

1. Sprint of epic 1d8b completed Phase G with P1=PASS.
2. Phase I invoked /dso:end-session --bump minor.
3. /dso:end-session created/updated PR #349 (session -> main).
4. PR #349 CI runs; llm-review job invokes INTEGRATION_SCOPE computation.
5. INTEGRATION_SCOPE step finds zero DSO-Story-Merge trailers on session branch.
6. emit-missing-trailer-warning.sh emits ::warning:: per db71's F4 fix.
7. llm-review falls through to reviewing the full PR #349 diff (~7000 lines).
8. User observes the review is taking >25min and asks whether it is scoped.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

- The db71 fix was scoped to `local` mode (where `merge-story-branch.sh` runs locally before pushing).
- ci-pr mode bypasses `merge-story-branch.sh` for story->session merges entirely — the merge commit is created by GitHub.
- Neither the d039 follow-up (PR #350 fix/db71-followup-llm-review-cycle2) nor the original db71 PR (#348) addressed the GitHub-auto-merge code path.
- The sprint SKILL.md comment at Phase F Step 18 acknowledges the trailer is "NOT added locally" in ci-pr mode but does not redirect INTEGRATION_SCOPE to a GitHub-API-based provenance source.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* `/dso:sprint` Phase F Step 18 ci-pr branch (lines around plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md "if [[ "${SPRINT_MODE:-local}" == "ci-pr" ]]; then ... merge-to-main.sh ...")
* `.github/workflows/ci.yml` llm-review job, "Compute cross-branch file set from DSO-Story-Merge trailers" step (lines 483-499) and the empty-INTEGRATION_SCOPE fallback (lines 570-578)
* `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-story-branch.sh` (only invoked in local mode)
* `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-story-merge-trailer.sh` (positive-invariant gate from db71)
* `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh` ci-pr story-PR creation path

### 6. Logs

```
$ gh pr view 349 --json statusCheckRollup | python3 -c 'import json,sys; [print(c.get("name","?"),c.get("conclusion","?")) for c in json.load(sys.stdin)["statusCheckRollup"]]'
...
llm-review (still running — full PR diff scope)
...

$ git log origin/main..HEAD --grep='^DSO-Story-Merge:' --oneline
(no matches)
```
data.title: [sprint Phase F + ci.yml INTEGRATION_SCOPE]: ci-pr per-story PRs auto-merged by GitHub -> DSO-Story-Merge trailers absent on session branch -> llm-review falls through to full PR diff
